title: EventEnvelope
description: Common envelope for the events theclub-api publishes to Kafka. The three event schemas (bet-placed, round-settled, wallet-transaction) extend it via allOf and override `data` with their specific payload.

event_id.description: Generated exactly once when the outbox row is inserted; stable across retries. It's the deduplication key for the consumer.

occurred_at.description: Business time (when it happened), not Kafka publish time.

idempotency_key.description: The HTTP Idempotency-Key of the request that originated the event. null if the event doesn't come from a user request.

data.description: Payload specific to the event_type. See each event's schema.
